fine_tune_ctc_speech_recognition: fine-tune a HuggingFace CTC model for automatic speech recognition using command-line arguments or a JSON config file
create_vocabulary_from_datasets: create a vocabulary dictionary from training and evaluation datasets by extracting all unique characters
pad_audio_and_labels_batch: pad a batch of audio inputs and label sequences dynamically using the DataCollatorCTCWithPadding class
compute_wer_cer_metrics: compute word error rate and character error rate metrics for CTC model evaluation predictions
preprocess_audio_dataset: preprocess an audio dataset by loading audio, resampling, normalizing, and tokenizing target text
